title: Derived tensor with a module preserves an upper cohomological bound
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E an object of its derived category [def-pc-derived-category], and b an integer such that H^i(E)=0 for every i>b. Then for every structure-sheaf module F on X and every i>b, H^i(E\otimes^L F)=0, expressed by [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes].

source.place: Tag 08EV, lemma-perfect-direct-image, proof: upper bound for derived tensor; Tags 06YS and 06YD supply bounded-above flat representatives

proof.text: The standard derived-category t-structure represents E by a complex K termwise zero above b (Mathlib DerivedCategory.isLE_iff and exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isLE).
Apply bounded-above flat replacement to K, retaining the same termwise bound, to obtain a quasi-isomorphism P to K. The bounded-above flat complex P is K-flat and represents E.

For i>b and p+q=i, either p>b or q>0, so every tensor summand of P tensor F[0] in degree i is zero. Tensor is additive in each variable; coproduct extensionality makes the total term zero (WeilConjectures CochainComplex.isStrictlyLE_tensorObj). Thus its homology in degree i is zero. P witnesses the stated vanishing predicate.

theorem schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes_of_upper_bound
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (b : ℤ)
    (hE : ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (i : ℤ) (hi : b < i) :
    schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes X E F i
